prompt: Which is the highest waterfall in the world?
response: The highest waterfall in the world is the Victoria Falls in Zambia. It is located on the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe, and it is the highest waterfall in the world, standing at an elevation of 4,500 meters (14,800 feet) above sea level. The falls are formed by the confluence of the Zambezi and Chobe rivers, and they are a popular tourist attraction in Zambia.
